title: Tiny, cute roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff8fb8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e34f86'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='plate' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe27a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f2b52e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- boot upper -->
  <path d='M30 26 h30 a8 8 0 0 1 8 8 v14 h-20 v6 h-24 a7 7 0 0 1 -7 -7 v-13 a8 8 0 0 1 8 -8 z'
        fill='url(#boot)'/>
  <!-- boot collar highlight -->
  <path d='M30 26 h30 a8 8 0 0 1 8 8 h-38 a0 0 0 0 0 0 0 z' fill='#ffc2d9'/>
  <!-- lace points -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#fff6ef'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#fff6ef'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#fff6ef'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#fff6ef'/>
  <!-- laces -->
  <path d='M40 34 L52 43 M52 34 L40 43' stroke='#fff6ef' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- sole / plate -->
  <path d='M24 54 h52 a6 6 0 0 1 6 6 v3 h-64 v-3 a6 6 0 0 1 6 -6 z' fill='url(#plate)'/>
  <!-- plate front edge shading -->
  <path d='M82 54 a6 6 0 0 1 6 6 v3 h-8 v-9 z' fill='#d99a1c'/>

  <!-- axle bar -->
  <rect x='47' y='66' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#8f7bd6'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='82' r='12' fill='#57d4e8'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='82' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#b6f5ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='82' r='4' fill='#e9fdff'/>

  <circle cx='67' cy='82' r='12' fill='#57d4e8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='82' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#b6f5ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='82' r='4' fill='#e9fdff'/>

  <!-- toe cap highlight -->
  <path d='M74 30 a8 8 0 0 1 4 6 v2 h-6 z' fill='#ffc2d9'/>
</svg>
